description: Reads each source of a many-source film against the demands of the passes downstream: the questions it raises, the faces with a stake and what they chose, the turns (a value before and after, and what turned it), antagonisms, reveals, motif candidates, filmable places, objects and numbers, quotable lines, intensity, and what the source cannot support. Every element carries a verbatim anchor; the anchor wall drops the rest. One call per document; the result is a queryable ledger, not a summary.
researcher_question: What in this document could a film be made of, and where exactly does it say so?
